what: A lead requested a bot-authored draft before publishing its new branch. GitHub returned404 because the remote ref did not exist.
cause: The lead treated botpush --draft as both push and PR creation. That mode creates only the draft and never pushes.
fix: Use the regular bot push first, verify the exact remote head, then request the draft. Keep failed publication visible.
test: The script separates push from draft creation. A remote-ref read confirmed the branch was absent; the corrected order uses the existing push and draft paths. A preflight remote-ref check would catch this ordering mistake.
